integrity: The universal theorem is proved analytically; exhaustive computation for n=2..6 is used only as a finite stress test.
scientific limitations: The theorem determines the minimum Italian weight and all minimum functions, not the full Italian domination polynomial.
Only the publisher abstract and indexed text of a plausible 2019 source were accessible for comparison; an unindexed equivalent crown-graph result therefore remains a residual originality risk.
title: Minimum Italian domination on crown graphs
